description: WSO2 SAP Successfactors Position Management provides a way to interact with the [SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central APIs](https://api.sap.com/package/SuccessFactorsEmployeeCentral/overview). The service allows to manage organizational positions, position hierarchies, and position-related information.
key-features: Manage position creation and hierarchy in organizational structures
Configure position requisition workflows and approval status
Query position relationships and organizational reporting lines
